title: Blurry and mostly blue. Not quite as fun as the picture
text: Blurry and mostly blue. Not quite as fun as the picture. I love the idea behind the shower curtain but the fact that the printing is pretty blurry and not nearly as crisp as the picture I have to take a star off. It loses another star because though the picture does show that there is some blue tinge to the whole thing it’s a pretty substantially blue product. All of the black that shows in the picture actually reads as dark blue in person and overall the product is basically different shades of blue with a tiny bit of red and purple thrown in. I don’t hate it, it’s just not exactly as the picture shows and it’s enough of a difference that I can’t give full stars for this product.
